FIELDS.NAME: Grace Community Church
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Grace Community Church serves as a welcoming place of worship and community engagement, operating from a well-maintained facility that promotes a safe environment for all attendees. Our core operations include various church services, community outreach programs, and educational opportunities for all age groups. We have instituted robust child protection policies and conduct background checks for all staff and volunteers involved with children and youth programs. Our church features a commercial-grade kitchen that is subject to regular safety inspections, ensuring safe food service during community events. We prioritize safety through established emergency and evacuation plans for large gatherings. Through these initiatives, we aim to enhance our community's spiritual growth while minimizing risks associated with our operations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in clay or shale digging and confirms that no alcohol is served onsite without proper licensing and supervision. Additionally, we ensure that all staff and volunteers working with minors have completed necessary background checks, and we maintain updated and inspected electrical and heating systems within our facilities.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses reported on September 15, 2023, due to water damage from a burst pipe in the community center, amounting to $2,000. Currently in the repair process, with work expected to be completed by October 30, 2023.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial-grade safe, UL Class 350, Fire Resistant, NFPA approved.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the perimeter, with night watch personnel on weekends for added safety during community events.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Grace Community Church does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The activities focus on community services and worship, maintaining a safe environment for all attendees.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The facility manager, John Smith, checks the certificates to ensure compliance.

We maintain a commitment to ethical operations and safety within our community.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Grace Community Church has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. All previous coverages have been maintained without issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Grace Community Church does not lease employees to or from other employers; all employees are directly hired and managed by the church.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Grace Community Church carries Workers Compensation insurance, ensuring coverage for employees in accordance with legal requirements. This policy is active and in compliance with applicable regulations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Grace Community Church does not own or operate any other business. Our focus is solely on providing a welcoming environment for worship and community engagement.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Grace Community Church currently has no other insurance policies with this company. The existing policy covers all necessary aspects of our operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Grace Community Church is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus on community services and worship activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Grace Community Church does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations primarily focus on providing services and support to our community.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Grace Community Church has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The church maintains a stable financial position and operates within its means.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Grace Community Church does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus on safe community services and worship activities. We prioritize maintaining a safe environment for all attendees.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Grace Community Church does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on providing community services and worship activities in a safe environment, and we have no history of significant catastrophic events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Grace Community Church has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The church maintains robust child protection policies and conducts thorough background checks for all staff and volunteers involved with children and youth programs.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Grace Community Church currently does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. The facility is well-maintained and regularly inspected to ensure compliance with fire safety regulations.
